content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degree in life Sciences or allied subjects; For Engineering, Four Year Graduate Degree in life Sciences or allied subjects Experience: Desirable: experience in Bioinformatics and Molecular Biology techniques, specifically gene cloning, expression, purification of recombinant proteins and qPCR Other conditions: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Desirable: Knowledge of TA modules of bacterial system Experience in Bioinformatics and Molecular Biology techniques, specifically gene cloning, expression, purification of recombinant proteins and qPCR

content_sections.heading: How Will NSUT Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting Interview Shortlisted candidates will be informed for interview by e-mail At interview, candidates should be prepared to discuss qualifications, research experience and interest in Bioinformatics and Molecular Biology

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Cover letter describing research interests, relevant skills and motivation to join the team Updated curriculum vitae (CV) highlighting academic background and research experience Copies of academic transcripts and certificates Two professional references (contact information)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NSUT Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Candidates may send an updated curriculum vitae (CV) highlighting their academic background and research experience in advance to [email protected] . Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview by e-mail. Bring self-attested documents listed in the notice at the time of interview. Email it on or before 16 November 2026.
